fpga.title: R-12 — revocation nodes were never reused: the pool ran out at 65,532 allocations and the core DEADLOCKED. Fixed by the M1 reclaimer (`054cea69b`), on silicon since 2026-09-17
R-16 — the domain never returns from its FIRST entry (`SHA5` stall)
R-18 — a scalar in the upper half of a 16-byte cache row is silently zeroed on silicon
R-19 — a `movc rd, zero`-sourced store leaves `compress_cap(NULL)` in its OWN bank-1 slot
R-20 — after `stc`, a load into **x10** is read by the next instruction as the store's base address
R-25 — `INIT` with `rd != rs1` wrote the new LINEAR capability to BOTH registers
R-26 — a younger load is checked against the CPMP entry a pending `CCSRRW` is about to replace
R-27 — a pipeline flush during the DYN unit's revocation-node query leaves the core dead
R-29 — a plain 8-byte store adjacent to a 128-bit `ldc` of the same granule loses the high half

R-34 — every exception the load/store unit generates itself (the five capability causes 24–28 AND the misaligned causes 4/6) is LOST when the access is granted in its request cycle; it is delivered only if an exception is still being presented one cycle later
R-35 — on silicon a REVOKED capability still reads AND writes the storage its object has given up, at every age, and the access does not trap
R-42 — a speculative I-cache miss killed by a taken-branch redirect costs +1 cycle every loop iteration
R-43 — R-35's revocation cache refused LIVE capabilities once ~256 revocation ids were live. FIXED ON SILICON 2026-09-29 (`8f6a0af98`, `caplifive_r43_8f6a0af98.bit`)
SPEC VIOLATION — every capability `mcause` from the DATA path is one code too high, and 25 aliases
A domain enters with NO trap vector: `create_domain` never writes the trap-vector context slot
Release cost tracks GLOBAL PLACEMENT, not the arm: a 16-byte relocation moves `give_cyc/n` by 83 %
Every store routes capability metadata into the dcache write-user sideband
A ~1.6 MB pure-capability domain hangs after ANY perturbation of its image
S-06 — an untagged 128-bit `ldc`/`stc` round trip loses the HIGH 64 bits
S-07 — a capability read back from memory comes back UNTAGGED, sporadically
S-08 — on `caplifive_s06fullfix.bit` the monitor takes an UNHANDLED TRAP just after a domain's first share returns
S-09 — a capability survives the plain store meant to destroy it
S-10 — a scrubbed capability still reads back LIVE while the store is in the write buffer
S-11 — SEAL enforces neither its minimum size nor its base alignment
S-12 ROOT-CAUSED — 2026-09-03
S-13 — at `-O1` the domain HANGS in the DYN/rev-node path, with no exception
